notion-fetch._note: Two probes (a page id and a database id) returned the same four keys, so `id` is not a shape discriminator. `metadata` is a nested dict ({type: str}) and stays untyped; `text` carries the Notion-flavored Markdown body.

notion-get-comments._note: The probed page carries no discussions, so the response was an empty object `{}`. Nothing about the populated shape was observable; re-probe against a page with comments before shaping.

notion-get-teams._note: Both team lists came back empty in this workspace, so the element shape is unobservable. `joinedTeams`/`otherTeams` are hand-added as `list` (the empty-list exception) to keep them visible.

notion-get-users._note: Envelope is {results, has_more}; unwrapped to the record list. `email` was absent for every probed user, so it is not typed.

notion-list-private-pages._note: Same record shape as notion-list-favorite-pages, so the two share `SidebarPageSummary`. The envelope's `nextCursor` is dropped by the unwrap.

notion-list-recent-pages._note: Distinct model from SidebarPageSummary: recent entries also carry `icon`, which is absent on some rows and covered by total=False.

notion-list-shared-pages._note: `results` came back empty in this workspace, so the element shape was never observed. Unwrap-only: the envelope is stripped but the element stays Any rather than borrowing a shape from the sibling list tools.

notion-query-data-sources._note: The input `data` is itself a union (mode=sql | mode=view), but the selector is nested inside an object rather than a top-level scalar param, so overloads cannot key on it — resolved as a generic base model. Only `has_more` is a stable top-level scalar: `results` rows are the queried database's own columns (dynamic per data source) and `data_source_ids` is a list, so neither is typed. mode=view was not probed (no view URL reachable without a mutating tool).

notion-query-meeting-notes._note: Every response was an error rather than a result, so no shape was ever observed.

notion-search-agents._note: Both enum values of `scope` (favorites, workspace) returned an error envelope rather than a result, so the agent record shape was never observed.

notion-search._note: Confirmed discriminator: `query_type` is a two-value scalar enum and both values were probed separately. internal returns ranked content records; user returns a single blob whose `text` holds a <users-search-results> XML document. The envelope's `type` key echoes the mode (content_search / user_search) and is dropped by the unwrap.
